title: Audit the 2980/2981 archive receipt
body:
## Summary
- The archive receipt for #2980 and #2981 retains all sixteen installed blobs, and both reviewed heads are unchanged.
- The decisions stay partially reviewed, with archive-only closure and scientific execution still open. Four README predecessor sentences are outside the receipt and the two contributor lines.
- Partial retention only. No new kappa and no pull-request closure.
